name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_zmod_multi
title: Multi-column leaf keys over Z_q with norm-checked succinct-LWE trapdoors: real vs simulated within 2x LHL
statement: As AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_zmod, with a tuple of L independent leaf keys for the target columns U l: the real and simulated leaf views are within 2 * mW * sqrt(q^n / 2^m) / 2.
